title: ASHA workers launch indefinite protest; refuse to withdraw despite Health Minister’s assurance

ai.summary: Karnataka ASHA workers launched an indefinite protest demanding ₹15,000 monthly honorarium and fulfillment of pending dues, refusing to withdraw despite Health Minister U.T. Khader's assurances.

facts.claim: Karnataka ASHA workers launched an indefinite day-and-night protest at Freedom Park
facts.quote: Members of the Karnataka Rajya Samyuktha ASHA Karyakarteyara Sangha launched an indefinite day-and-night protest at Freedom Park here on Tuesday (November 17)

facts.claim: demanding that the State government fix their monthly honorarium at ₹15,000 and fulfil their pending demands
facts.quote: demanding that the State government fix their monthly honorarium at ₹15,000 and fulfil their pending demands

facts.claim: refused to withdraw despite assurances from Health Minister U.T. Khader
facts.quote: The workers refused to withdraw their agitation despite assurances from Health Minister U.T. Khader

facts.claim: Health Minister U.T. Khader said he would take up the demand for an increase in the monthly honorarium to ₹15,000 with the Chief Minister at the Cabinet meeting scheduled for November 19
facts.quote: Addressing the protesters, Mr. Khader said he would take up the demand for an increase in the monthly honorarium to ₹15,000 with the Chief Minister at the Cabinet meeting scheduled for November 19

facts.claim: Health Minister U.T. Khader promised a meeting on November 18 with Health Department officials and union representatives to address complaints regarding the non-payment of the pending ₹8,000 honorarium and other dues
facts.quote: He also promised them that a meeting would be held on November 18 with Health Department officials and union representatives to address complaints regarding the non-payment of the pending ₹8,000 honorarium and other dues

facts.claim: Union representatives said the agitation would continue and be intensified until the government took concrete steps to fulfil their demands
facts.quote: Union representatives said the agitation would continue and be intensified until the government took concrete steps to fulfil their demands

facts.claim: Former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah had promised a minimum monthly honorarium of ₹10,000, but the assurance remained unfulfilled
facts.quote: He recalled that former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah had promised a minimum monthly honorarium of ₹10,000, but the assurance remained unfulfilled

ai.background_note: ASHA workers in Karnataka have been demanding higher honorariums and fulfillment of pending dues since the state government failed to honor former Chief Minister Siddaramaiah's promise of ₹10,000 monthly payment.
